title.it: USA rivedono licenze export per H200 e MI325X
title.en: The US reviews export licences for the H200 and MI325X

description.it: Washington introduce una valutazione caso per caso per certi chip avanzati destinati alla Cina, dopo controlli irrigiditi nel 2025.
description.en: Washington introduces case-by-case review for certain advanced chips destined for China, after controls were tightened in 2025.
